name: Cube-Completion Width
definition: For a nonempty displayed binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$, the cube-completion width is the prescribed-subset ordering width $\sigma(\{0,1\}^X;C)$: the minimum width of an order of the full ambient cube whose first $|C|$ concepts are exactly $C$.
parameters: A finite nonempty binary class together with its displayed ambient coordinate set $X$.
normalization: The ambient coordinates are retained. The internal order of $C$ and the continuation through its complement are both optimized.
comments: The value is invariant under cube symmetries and under adding or deleting constant coordinates, but its definition remembers the positioned ambient cube.
